landing.headline: The smarter way to
landing.description: TeachMe builds real fluency from the ground up. For some languages that means mastering the writing system first — then pronunciation, vocabulary, and grammar.
landing.featuresTitle: Built around how languages actually work
landing.f1Desc: Korean starts with Hangeul, Japanese with Hiragana. Before vocabulary comes the alphabet — we make sure you nail it before moving on.
landing.f2Desc: The SM-2 spaced repetition algorithm shows you each item exactly when you're about to forget it — maximising retention in minimal time.
landing.f3Desc: Structured levels that guide you from your first character all the way to reading sentences. No guessing what to study next.
landing.koreanDesc: Master Hangeul — one of the world's most logical alphabets — then build vocabulary and conversational skills on solid foundations.
landing.japaneseDesc: A complete Japanese path — from Hiragana and Katakana to essential Kanji, vocabulary, and grammar.
landing.ctaDesc: Join thousands of learners and start reading Korean in under a week.
landing.mockSub: Pick a language and keep going.
landing.dlDesc: TeachMe is also available as a native desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux — built with Tauri for a fast, lightweight experience.
landing.dlNote: Desktop builds are coming soon. In the meantime, use the web app for free.
